svg.title: Figure 4-2: Risk and Mitigation Pairs
svg.desc: Seven rows, each showing a risk on the left and its corresponding mitigation on the right, connected by an arrow.

g.text: Verify facts before relying on them
Policy on what stays in; procurement standards
Map obligations before deploying; involve legal
Audit outputs; human review of individual decisions
Supervision proportional to audience and stakes
Treat key skills as deliberate practice
Measure net value, not gross output

svg.text: Each risk has a specific mitigation. None requires abandoning AI adoption — only managing it deliberately.
